import sys
import math

def gcd(a, b):
    while b > 0:
        r = a % b
        a = b
        b = r
    return a

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x, y, n = map(int, data[:3])

    g = gcd(x, y)
    x //= g
    y //= g

    if n >= y:
        print(f"{x}/{y}")
        return

    target = x / y
    best_error = target
    ans = [0] * n
    best_den = 1

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        h = i * target
        low = math.floor(h)
        err_low = abs(low / i - target)
        err_high = abs((low + 1) / i - target)

        if best_error > err_low or best_error > err_high:
            if err_low > err_high:
                ans[i - 1] = int(low) + 1
                best_den = i
                best_error = err_high
            else:
                ans[i - 1] = int(low)
                best_den = i
                best_error = err_low

    print(f"{ans[best_den - 1]}/{best_den}", end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
